62.sourceTitle: Aluminium Premium Duty paid US Midwest Price Today - Investing.com
62.evidenceText: Prev. Close: 1,793.99 (for Aluminium Premium Duty paid US Midwest, symbol LUPc1)
62.extractionRationale: The source shows 1,793.99 as the previous close price for the Aluminium Premium Duty paid US Midwest (LUPc1).
